target_text: USMC SBDs (VMSB 142) from Henderson Field, with TBFs (VT 8) and USMC TBFs (VMSB 131), sink battleship Hiei
notes: Cressman, 13 November 1942: battleship Hiei, already damaged by gunfire in the Friday the 13th night action, is sunk by TBFs (VT 8) from Enterprise and USMC SBDs (VMSB 142) and TBFs (VMSB 131) from Henderson Field. This is a shore-based Cactus Air Force mission from Henderson Field (existing VMSB-142 base claims). Confidence 0.7: one official Navy chronology (mission rubric). The target place is Ironbottom Sound (kind area), not a sea_position.
